ski.name: THE BOWL BELOW THE COL
ski.hello: THE BOWL. KNEE-DEEP AND UNTRACKED BUT FOR YESTERDAY'S TWO LINES.

interactions.label: THE CROSS
interactions.dialog: AN IRON CROSS ON A CAIRN, RIMED WHITE ON ITS WINDWARD SIDE, PRAYER FLAGS SNAPPING FROM IT TO A POLE. BEHIND YOU THE GLACIER YOU CAME UP; IN FRONT, THE BOWL, AND FAR BELOW IT A SMUDGE OF STEAM WHERE NO STEAM SHOULD BE.

interactions.label: SIGN
interactions.dialog:
COL DU VENT, 3,412.
REFUGE DU COL ..... 1 H 30 (ON FOOT)
................... 6 MIN (ON SKIS, IF YOU'RE GOOD)
